name: async-batchable-passive-contracts
salesforceExclusionReason: The access-level QueryLocator and QueryLocatorWithBinds overloads do not compile in the target API 67 scratch org, and the hosted runner cannot execute this combined local async contract. Retain local batch/iterator proof and exclude hosted runtime.

source.content: public class BatchPassiveContractsFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Account> { public Iterable<Account> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { System.assertNotEquals('', bc.getJobId()); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Passive-%' ORDER BY Name]; return rows; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Account> scope) { for (Account row : scope) { insert new Account(Name = 'Handled-' + row.Name); } } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { insert new Account(Name = 'Done-' + bc.getJobId()); } }

@isTest private class AsyncBatchablePassiveContractsFixtureTest { @isTest static void provesPassiveBatchableContractsAndObjectAccessLevel() { insert new Account(Name = 'Passive-One'); AccessLevel access = AccessLevel.USER_MODE; Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Passive-One\'', access); Database.QueryLocatorIterator locatorIterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(locatorIterator.hasNext()); Account locatorRow = (Account) locatorIterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Passive-One', locatorRow.Name); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('wanted', 'Passive-One'); Database.QueryLocator bindLocator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted', binds, access); Database.QueryLocatorIterator bindIterator = bindLocator.iterator(); System.assert(bindIterator.hasNext()); Account bindRow = (Account) bindIterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Passive-One', bindRow.Name); Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new BatchPassiveContractsFixtureBatch(), 1); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Handled-Passive-One']); String doneName = 'Done-' + jobId; System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :doneName]); } }
